BL-1109 — Babysitter STARVED treats an idle-owner in_process claim as no motion, and its CRIT claims the mailbox is empty when claims exist
What it solves: Source intake: .swarmforge/operator/INTAKE-babysitter-starved-misses-worktree-mailboxes.md (2026-08-23). Human sentences from the Ask section preserved above. Observed with QA on BL-1099 and documenter on BL-1087; assigned_to: coder was stale mono-router entry assignment.
Approval context: Firm: a non-abandoned in_process claim is motion for check 10 even when the owner pane is momentarily idle, and the CRIT copy must never claim zero parcels when claims were counted. Also firm: align the starved gather glob with stuck-in-process so batch_/nested worktree claims are visible.
